name: UR Delver
notes: Faithful 60-card Legacy UR Delver tempo. One-mana threats + burn backed by free counters (Daze/Force) and cantrips. ENGINE-RISK (faithful, no-compromise build): Delver of Secrets is a double-faced (transform) card; Young Pyromancer makes tokens off every noncreature spell; Gitaxian Probe / Daze have alternative costs. Delver's flip and the 'hold up Daze' tempo lines are poorly modeled by CP7.
